Ready for the maintainer to merge after #2112. No blocking findings.

I used the current rules in `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`. The local trial merge used main at `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6`. The merge had no conflicts.

What I checked:

- The last commit adds tests and a decision record only. It meets the three test requirements in #2113. The earlier commits are from #2112, which has a clean collaborator review at `71a7fee47351ae5e513b4cfbebfbd04868a7ad28`.
- I treated the combined change as a safety review because it includes the rest Adaptive toolpath generator. I read the stock, entry, raster, pass, and output checks. Uncertain stock counts as material. An entry needs a clear cutter footprint. A failed load or coverage check gives a named error.
- The new entry test gives the raster material that the polygon does not contain. It checks both an unsafe entry and a clear entry. This isolates the raster check from the polygon check.
- The load tests use D/80 and D/240 stock grids. They check both cut depths, load limits, coverage, entry clearance, and path verification. The D/80 limit is optimal load times 1.2. The D/240 limit is optimal load times 1.05. Existing tests keep their load limit.
- No goldens moved. No UI, snapshot PNG, dependency, script, workflow, build script, or process file changed. The tests are in the motion crate. The decision record explains the fixture and grid choices.

Local results on the trial merge:

| Command or suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test rest_adaptive` | 11 passed, 57.46 s |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib rest` | 12 passed, 133.89 s |
| `rest2d` | 10 passed |
| `adaptive_hsm` | 1 passed, 5 ignored in the heavy lane |
| `optimal_load` | 4 passed |
| `machining2d` | 66 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` | Plan checked; this did not run the full gate |

The selected tests total 104 passes. One existing adaptive trochoid library test took more than 60 seconds. App, UI, and release suites were not run. The change is additive in motion; the last commit changes tests only. No GitHub runner was used.

I ran both stated mutations separately in the local review worktree:

1. Remove `&& self.stock.air(p, p, self.footprint)` from `Entries::proved`: the new entry test failed at `rest/tests.rs:228`.
2. Set the raster footprint to `0.0`: the same test failed at the same assertion.

Both failures had this text:

```text
a plunge onto the raster's material was proved clear
```

I restored each mutation. The restored entry test passed again. The tracked tree has no remaining changes.

Requested before merge: none. Keep the stated merge order: #2112 first, then #2114.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The merge batch on main `aaddb2d48` did not merge this PR. The PR conflicts with main in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/rest/tests.rs` and `crates/motion/tests/rest_adaptive/main.rs`: main added the travel-budget tests (from #2116) and this PR added the entry-proof and D/80 load tests at the same places. The resolution is a hand edit, so it is a DELTA refresh. The label is now `conflicts` in place of `merge-ready`. Merge `origin/main` into the branch, then ask for a delta review of the merge.

Stopped before push. The remote head remains `c234093ee332399353c2891b22ce1ef5d30c3081`.
Local branch `issue/2113-rest-adaptive-pins` retains merge `ee1d214733ab4bafde890be6c9030d716eda70f4`.
It merges upstream main `4b7a6b1e87d3db22222ea3132f95a45f20a45f8a`.
Both conflict files keep both sets of tests. No guard or limit changed.

The quick gate failed. `on_a_fine_grid_the_corners_read_within_the_planning_margin` fails at `rest_adaptive/main.rs:286`.
Main's travel budget refuses its fixture before the load measurement:

```text
rest Adaptive at Z-2.000 would feed 199 mm out of cut for 64 mm in cut (over 3.0x) - choose Waterline or Offset rings
```

Results:

- Motion library: 398 passed, 6 ignored.
- `adaptive_band`: 2 passed. `adaptive_hsm`: 2 passed, 5 ignored.
- `adaptive_orbit_seam`: 1 passed. `pocket3d_hsm`: 3 passed, 1 ignored.
- `rest_adaptive`: 10 passed, 1 failed. The D/80 pin passed.
- `shape_masks`: 13 passed.
- Clippy on all motion targets passed with warnings denied.

The raster-entry and travel-budget pins each caught two mutations.
Removing the raster check or setting its footprint to zero failed the entry pin.
Disabling either travel limit failed the budget pin.
All four restored runs passed.

The fine-grid fixture now fails main's preserved travel limit.
Please do a delta re-review of the merge and this fixture failure.

Stopped before push. The remote head remains `c234093ee332399353c2891b22ce1ef5d30c3081`.

The requested conflict refresh is retained locally on `fix-2114`, merge commit `a49a131f278f467a123fad7caf959383db52137e`. It merges upstream main `1f15f98e7c68cb84e49b80d5d3c1676dcab524ac`.
Both conflicting files keep both sets of tests. No guard or refusal changed. PROCESS_VERSION, changelog, and recommendations match main.

The quick gate is red. `on_a_fine_grid_the_corners_read_within_the_planning_margin` fails at `rest_adaptive/main.rs:286`. Main's travel limit refuses 199 mm out-of-cut feed for 64 mm in-cut feed (over 3.0x). The other results are 433 passed and 12 ignored. Motion clippy passed with warnings denied.

The retained entry proof pin catches removal of the raster air check. The retained travel-budget pin catches disabling either the air limit or the hop limit. Each mutation failed. Each restored test passed.

I left the fixture and travel limit unchanged because the review requested only a conflict refresh. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed. Please re-review the merge and the fine-grid fixture failure before the refresh can be pushed.

Stopped before push because the quick gate is red. The remote head remains `c234093ee332399353c2891b22ce1ef5d30c3081`.

The requested conflict refresh is retained locally on `fix-2114-current` at `13392406e71dbf95667aeb01a6048fee6b992246`. It merges upstream main `e3f7d122b3c7fb86aff4c893667f02378fc707d8`.
Both conflict files keep both sets of tests. No production guard or refusal changed. PROCESS_VERSION, CHANGELOG.md and RECOMMENDED.md match main.

Pins checked:
- `the_raster_half_of_the_entry_proof_refuses_on_its_own`: removing the raster air check failed; restoring it passed. Setting the footprint to zero failed; restoring it passed.
- `the_travel_budget_refuses_by_name_past_each_limit`: disabling the air limit failed; restoring it passed. Disabling the hop limit failed; restoring it passed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: red. 433 passed, 1 failed, 12 ignored. `on_a_fine_grid_the_corners_read_within_the_planning_margin` fails because main's preserved travel limit refuses 199 mm out-of-cut feed for 64 mm in-cut feed at Z-2.000 (over 3.0x).
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The fixture is unchanged because the requested finding was a conflict refresh. No screenshots, logs or review evidence were committed. Please re-review the local merge resolution and the fine-grid fixture failure. No new head was pushed.

Author-side refresh remains stopped before push. Remote head is still `c234093ee332399353c2891b22ce1ef5d30c3081`.

The latest review on that head requests no code changes. I addressed the maintainer's subsequent conflict-refresh finding locally: branch `fix-2114-review`, merge `d7ae746c630e62015832a5da987f5497d9d98af0`, merging upstream main `4e0b9abefcb225595d47d9c69a2482d6359b190f`. Both conflicting test files keep both sides. No fixture, assertion, production guard, or refusal changed. The diff against main contains only the PR's original four files.

Verification:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 433 passed, 1 failed, 12 ignored.
- Sole failure: `on_a_fine_grid_the_corners_read_within_the_planning_margin`, `crates/motion/tests/rest_adaptive/main.rs:286`: `rest Adaptive at Z-2.000 would feed 199 mm out of cut for 64 mm in cut (over 3.0x) - choose Waterline or Offset rings`.
- Raster-entry and travel-budget unit pins passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The resolve-conflicts skill requires stopping when a failure belongs to main's code or the PR's logic. The unchanged fine-grid fixture failure is outside this conflict-only finding, so no new head was pushed. No review evidence or logs were committed.

The latest review requested no code changes. I resolved the main conflicts by keeping both sets of tests.

`the_raster_half_of_the_entry_proof_refuses_on_its_own` keeps the raster guard pinned. `the_travel_budget_refuses_by_name_past_each_limit` keeps main's travel refusal pinned. Removing each guard failed its test. Restoring each guard passed.

Main's 3x travel refusal rejects the former 26 x 22 fine-grid fixture. `on_a_fine_grid_the_corners_read_within_the_planning_margin` now uses the same legal 60 x 40 conventional corner fixture as the default-grid check. The 0.3 mm stock allowance, corner-only bound, load ceiling, and residual-area assertion are unchanged. It also pins the actual D/240 cell and grid size. The old fixture is RED; the corrected fixture is GREEN. Both depths read 14.2027% of D with no remaining material in reach.

Merged main: c5eb07fa1. Main's PROCESS_VERSION and release files are preserved.
New head: 94ea5919c1df597dd84bf244856c589307d3fe45.

Validation on the final head: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 8 steps (0 failed). Strict motion all-target Clippy passed.

The PR is a draft. Existing labels are untouched. Please re-review this head.
